in_hebrew.name: Gereron
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Jerry or Gerald
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gereron הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Greek word 'geranos' meaning 'crane' or 'geras' meaning 'valor'. Gereron may have been a name given to a warrior or someone associated with cranes.

in_greek.name: Gereron

in_greek.long_meaning: Gereron είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Greek word 'geranos' meaning 'crane' or 'geras' meaning 'valor'. Gereron may have been a name given to a warrior or someone associated with cranes.

in_latin.name: Gereron
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Jerry or Gerald
in_latin.long_meaning: Gereron est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Greek word 'geranos' meaning 'crane' or 'geras' meaning 'valor'. Gereron may have been a name given to a warrior or someone associated with cranes.
